title: Multimodal RewardBench 2: Evaluating Omni Reward Models for Interleaved Text and Image

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating each response pair twice with swapped orderings (A vs. B and B vs. A) to measure and mitigate the judge models' systematic preference for the first item presented.
Constructing mixed-modality preference pairs (e.g., text-only vs. image+text) and comparing judge performance to measure if models exhibit a systematic bias toward responses that contain images.
